thread:
Ava: Quick sync — collecting owners and timelines for the DR follow-ups from last week's regional failover. I want a concise owner + ETA for each action item. I'll keep the running list in the continuity playbook. Please reply with short lines only (owner: item — eta).

Mike: Mike: Owner: multi-region routing policy tests + canary failback run. Item: add deterministic route weights, test failover traffic shaping. ETA: 2 weeks (1796505721).

Sarah: Sarah: Owner: backups & restore runbook refresh. Item: update incremental snapshot docs, add runbook step for partial region restores, run a restore dry-run during next game day. ETA: 1 week (1796504921).

Jin: Jin: Owner: runtime fallback tuning and alerts. Item: tighten circuit-breaker thresholds, add latency-painted metrics to SLO dashboard, add alarm for KV cache bloat. ETA: 3 days (1796504550).

Priya: Priya: Owner: ops coordination & game day scheduling. Item: schedule regional failover game day, coordinate oncall rotation and blast radius controls, secure staging capacity. Proposed date: Thu Apr 1 2026. ETA: schedule by EOD Fri.

Ava: Noted. Two patterns we noticed across incidents: 1) restore time variance tied to incremental snapshot retention; 2) route config drift between regions during autoscale. We should add specific regression checks to prevent repeats.

Mike: Agree on route drift. Action: create a small CI check that validates route hashes across regions on deploys. I'll pair with Platform. ETA: 9 days.

Sarah: For backups, suggestion: add a post-snapshot integrity check that verifies incremental chain before accepting snapshot for restores. I'll PR the check.

Jin: For alerts, I'll add a new pager policy scoped to restore-time anomalies (5min window) and a runbook link in the alert.

Priya: OpsBot: can you create the calendar invite and stub the game day runbook?

OpsBot: OpsBot: Created event "Regional Failover Game Day — dry run" on Thu Apr 1 2026. Stub playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/regional-failover. Invite sent to oncall rotation.

Ava: Great. Next steps: everyone paste final owner: item — exact ETA by EOD today so I can update the tracker and assign follow-ups in the playbook. We'll do a 20-min sync Monday to confirm progress.

Mike: Done (owner + ETA posted above).

Sarah: Done — will open PR today and link it in the playbook.

Jin: Done — alert + runbook link will be in the alert PR.

Priya: Done — calendar invite + ops checklist is live.

Ava: Thanks all. I'll push the consolidated action list to the continuity playbook and ping owners for weekly check-ins until items are closed. :thumbsup:
